pundit.name: Clint Dempsey
pundit.take: **"Mustard Boy" Zach might need a map 'cause he's lost out there with his picks.** Yesterday's beatdown of Switzerland by Argentina exposed Zach's strategy like a winger tryin' to play sweeper. With Brazil not quite livin' up to the samba, and Saudi Arabia hittin' like a dead ball, Zach's got some soul searchin' to do. Meanwhile, "Bubba G" Gunner and "Ghost Pepper" Devin are squarin' off in Arlington with France and Spain goin' toe-to-toe. Look, France's attack is as spicy as a Texas BBQ pit, but Gunner might be bluffin' like he picked DR Congo hopin' they're hidden world-beaters. Devin's Spain is lookin' slicker than an oil spill off the Gulf, but I reckon Gunner's gonna edge this one out, ridin' France's flair like he stumbled on a cheat code. Back yourselves, fellas, but my money's on France puttin' the peppers back in their place.
